info.name: FinanceOS API
info.description:
Postman collection for FinanceOS server (`/api/v1`).

1. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:5000/api/v1)
2. Run **Auth → Login** — token is saved automatically
3. Demo user: aarav@example.com / demo1234
4. List endpoints save sample IDs into collection variables when possible

exec: try { const id = res.data.id; if (id) pm.collectionVariables.set('accountId', id); } catch(e) {}
